name: 1 to 3 noodles chatpat masala
ingredients_raw: Instant noodles: refined wheat flour (maida), palmolein oil, iodised salt, acidity regulators (INS 500(i), INS 501(i)) & stabiliser (INS 451(i)). Chatpat masala: mixed spices (34.3%) (onion, red chilli, coriander, jeera, turmeric, garlic, fenugreek, black pepper, clove & asafoetida), iodised salt, sugar, instant noodles powder (refined wheat flour (maida), palmolein oil, iodised salt, acidity regulators (INS 500(i), INS 501(i)) & stabiliser (INS 451(i))), corn starch, palmolein oil, yeast extract powder, hydrolysed vegetable protein (soya), flavour enhancers (INS 621, INS 635) & acidity regulators (INS 330, INS 296) (contains added flavours (nature identical flavouring substances)).
